treatment: Against one retained A01 fixture, run the existing five exact/conflicting duplicate cases, four unknown outer-event mutations, and two legacy input_release_transition mutations. AST-extract the exact input_edge_receipts function from the frozen A02B baseline and candidate projectors; run the same three exact regression methods on each.
decision_rule: Baseline expected to fail unknown-event duplicate DOWN/UP and legacy-transition duplicate UP by exposing a paired receipt. Candidate must pass all three methods; all unsupported/legacy edge mutations must produce one incomplete adapter receipt with both timing intervals null. Unique fixture receipt and five exact duplicate controls remain valid/closed as encoded in the existing test.

uncertainty: One synthetic retained X-adapter fixture and deterministic projector only; no live X-server, physical dwell, application consumption, task effect, threat response, recovery or MAP01 result.
